psychological_meaning: Spring Leaves evokes feelings of growth, renewal, and tranquility. It is associated with nature, health, and well-being, often bringing a sense of calm and balance. This color can promote feelings of optimism and harmony, reminding us of fresh starts and the vibrancy of the natural world.
